high_risk_reason: Nadi carries the highest single weight (8). Nakshatra->nadi classification and the same-rashi / same-lord / same-nakshatra-different-pada exceptions are school-variable. All cancellation is handled in parihara.json (disabled by default).
description: Nadi koota — traditional CONSTITUTIONAL-temperament compatibility from the nadi (Aadi/Vata, Madhya/Pitta, Antya/Kapha) of each janma nakshatra. Same nadi on both sides = Nadi dosha (0); different nadi = full 8.

safety_constraint.rule: Nadi is presented ONLY as traditional constitutional-temperament compatibility. It MUST NEVER be surfaced, worded, or interpreted as medical, genetic, fertility, pregnancy, progeny, or health information. AI and interpretation layers must enforce this. Nadi dosha is NOT a health warning.

nadi_gloss_caveat: The Vata/Pitta/Kapha glosses are traditional labels ONLY and must not be read as Ayurvedic medical diagnosis or any health claim (DEC-021).

dosha.name: Nadi dosha
dosha.exceptions: Handled in parihara.json ONLY (nadi_cancel_same_rashi_diff_nakshatra, nadi_cancel_same_nakshatra_diff_pada, nadi_cancel_lords_friends) — disabled by default.
dosha.same_rashi_same_lord_note: Same-rashi (different nakshatra) and same-lord conditions are classical cancellation candidates, defined and gated in parihara.json.

notes: Aadi(Vata) = Ashwini, Ardra, Punarvasu, Uttara Phalguni, Hasta, Jyeshtha, Mula, Shatabhisha, Purva Bhadrapada.
Madhya(Pitta) = Bharani, Mrigashira, Pushya, Purva Phalguni, Chitra, Anuradha, Purva Ashadha, Dhanishta, Uttara Bhadrapada.
Antya(Kapha) = Krittika, Rohini, Ashlesha, Magha, Swati, Vishakha, Uttara Ashadha, Shravana, Revati.
DEC-021 HARD constraint: constitutional framing only — never medical/genetic/fertility/pregnancy/progeny/health.
